'''Almar Upside''' was the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Almar]]. Originally intended as a resort for the wealthy, the station was owned by a company based on [[Derilyn]]. When [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces took control of Derilyn, company records were wiped so there was no official ownership of the station. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] quietly took control of the station, using it as a listening post directed towards [[Imperial Interdicted Space]]. On the surface, the station is maintained as an independent space facility, and the Alliance presence is well hidden.<ref name="PotG3" />
